description: Tiered auto-update policy (frontier vs core). Frontier attrs are promoted one per run into nix/overlays/fast-lane-manifest.nix by scripts/maintenance/aq-update-tiers. Every attr listed resolves via nix eval against both nixpkgs and nixpkgs-unstable (verified 2026-10-01). Deliberately excluded: python3 (3.13 -> 3.14 runtime major under services) and postgresql (17 -> 18 on-disk major); both stay core.

kernel.policy: Newest stable kernel, always (owner security protocol 2026-10-01; matches mySystem.kernel.track = latest-stable, host mkForce). Not LTS: upstream fixes land in the newest stable first, LTS receives selected backports later, and the 2026 AI-driven CVE volume (400+ kernel CVEs in a day) makes per-CVE backport triage unworkable. Promote to the fast lane whenever nixpkgs-unstable carries a newer linuxPackages_latest than stable.
kernel.activation: Patched != running: NixOS has no live patching, so a kernel update is only effective after reboot. The pipeline stages the switch and records pending_reboot_since; U4 escalates when a security kernel is pending past the reboot SLA. Previous generations stay in the boot menu as fallback; post-boot audio/GPU/inference probes gate acceptance.

media.note: Install-only: a global override cascades ~60 extra local builds (qtwebengine, opencv, torchaudio).

core.policy: Everything not listed under frontier stays on the stable nixpkgs input and moves only with the monthly stable bump through its tier gate.
